chunks: Al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام.
Regarding a man who accepted Islam and then killed a man by mistake, he said:
“I distribute the blood-money among those like him from among the people who have accepted Islam and have no mawali.”
ai.seo_question: How is the diyah assigned when a Muslim convert with no mawali commits accidental killing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about liability for blood-money in the case of an accidental killing committed by a person who accepted Islam and has no mawali. Imam 'Ali عليه السلام states that the diyah is apportioned among people similar to him from among those who accepted Islam and do not have mawali.
